problem: An image on another text page disabled real two-column sections; restoring columns exposed clamping of negative column displacement and mismatched fractional section rounding.
change: Keep per-page column sections across images on other text pages; carry owned image payloads and end sections on the final text/image block. Compute column origins from emitted Word section units and retain signed source offsets only within verified columns.

validation.source_views_and_rendering: Six owned native output pages individually viewed;2 actual WASM first-image PNGs byte-identical to viewed native. Other known public/BERT outputs unchanged byte-for-byte in their respective backend.
validation.remaining_fidelity: Image-containing page itself stays legacy layout; baseline/font substitution remains. BERT16->32 unchanged; full production readiness false.

owned_render.scope: Selected authored labels, columns on image-free pages and image section membership; not full image-page layout or arbitrary-font fidelity.

BERT.scope: Previously reviewed development paper, not a new holdout. Original selected Table1 gold and font-policy exclusions preserved; this change does not solve the paper.

browser_artifact_evidence.note: First-image DOCX relationship IDs differ from fresh native process after earlier browser conversions. Actual WASM render is checked instead of claiming byte equality.

limits: Narrow-gutter papers and inferred-table/prose ambiguity remain unresolved
Pages containing images or tables themselves keep legacy layout
Documents with positioned tables or OCR are outside this multipage-column path
Image-only/blank-page mixtures and Microsoft Word rendering remain unqualified
Font substitution and first-baseline offsets persist; no full geometry or production-readiness claim

evidence.own_generated_inputs_only: External source PDFs remain ignored; only existing3 public PDFs tracked.
evidence.timing_record_correction: Owned first-image source views and authored reference/hash preceded browser launch; a later JSON incorrectly claimed no conversion yet. Original recording error and explicit correction retained; not used as a holdout timing proof.
